questions.question: 42 can be shown as 4 tens and 2 ones. Which is another way to show 42?
questions.explain: You can trade one ten for ten ones, so 3 tens and 12 ones is still 42. A common trap is to just add the digits, like 5 plus 3.

questions.question: 71 can be shown as 7 tens and 1 one. Which is another way to show 71?
questions.explain: Trade one ten for ten ones and you get 6 tens and 11 ones, which is still 71. Don't just add the two digits together.

questions.question: 64 can be shown as 6 tens and 4 ones. Which is another way to show 64?
questions.explain: Trade one ten for ten ones and you get 5 tens and 14 ones, which is still 64. The number does not change when you trade.

questions.question: 82 can be shown as 8 tens and 2 ones. Which is another way to show 82?
questions.explain: Trade one ten for ten ones and you get 7 tens and 12 ones, which is still 82. A ten always equals ten ones.

questions.question: You have 56 sticks. You make 5 bundles of 10 and keep 6 loose. If you make 4 bundles of 10 instead, how many sticks are loose?
questions.explain: 56 is 5 tens and 6 ones, or 4 tens and 16 ones. One fewer bundle of 10 means 10 more loose sticks. A common trap is to just keep the 6.

questions.question: Sam has 73 blocks. He says, '7 tens and 3 ones.' His friend says, 'No, it is 6 tens and 13 ones.' Who is right?
questions.explain: Both are right because 73 is 7 tens and 3 ones, and also 6 tens and 13 ones. Trading a ten for ten ones does not change the number.

questions.question: You have 45 marbles in a jar. You can show 45 as 4 tens and 5 ones, or as 3 tens and some ones. How many ones is that?
questions.explain: 45 is 4 tens and 5 ones, or 3 tens and 15 ones. One fewer ten means 10 more ones. Don't just write the ones digit.

questions.question: Lila says 86 is 7 tens and 16 ones. Her brother says, '7 plus 16 is 23, not 86.' What is his mistake?
options: He thought a trade changes it
He mixed up tens and ones
questions.explain: The 7 means 7 tens, not 7 ones, so you cannot just add 7 plus 16. 7 tens and 16 ones is 70 plus 16, which is 86.

questions.question: You have 72 counters. You make 5 groups of 10 and keep the rest loose. How many counters are loose?
questions.explain: 72 is 7 tens and 2 ones, or 5 tens and 22 ones. Two fewer groups of 10 means 20 more loose counters. Don't just write the ones digit.

questions.question: You have 63 seeds to plant. You make 6 rows of 10 and 3 extra. If you make 4 rows of 10 instead, how many seeds are extra?
questions.explain: 63 is 6 tens and 3 ones, or 4 tens and 23 ones. Two fewer rows of 10 means 20 more extra seeds. The total stays 63.

questions.question: A box has 85 beads. You can show it as 8 tens and 5 ones, or as 6 tens and some ones. How many ones the second way?
questions.explain: 85 is 8 tens and 5 ones, or 6 tens and 25 ones. Two fewer tens means 20 more ones. Don't just add the two digits.

questions.question: Maya has 38 stickers. She makes 3 strips of 10 and keeps 8 loose. Now she makes only 2 strips of 10. How many stickers are loose?
questions.explain: Two strips hold 20 stickers, so the other 18 are loose. Opening a strip does not change 38; it just moves 10 stickers into the loose pile.

questions.question: Ava collects 29 shells at the beach. She fills bags of 10 shells and keeps the rest loose. Which is another way to show her 29 shells?
questions.explain: Open one bag and its 10 shells join the 9 loose ones, so 1 ten and 19 ones is still 29. Keeping 2 tens with 19 ones would make 39 shells.

questions.question: Noah strings 76 beads for a craft. He shows them as some tens and 16 ones. How many tens does he have?
questions.explain: The 16 ones hold 1 ten inside them, so 6 tens and 16 ones make 76. Keeping all 7 tens with 16 ones would give 86, which is too many.

questions.question: Liam has 4 bags with 10 marbles in each bag. He also has 16 loose marbles. How many marbles does Liam have in all?
questions.explain: The 16 loose marbles make 1 more ten and 6 ones, so 4 tens and 16 ones is 5 tens and 6 ones, or 56. Adding 4 and 16 forgets that each bag holds 10 marbles.
